job.name: ig43_host
job.style: Photorealistic cinematic still, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
job.style_qa: фотореализм, мужчина ~40 на подкасте в тёмной библиотеке, микрофон, смотрит в камеру, губы приоткрыты, без надписей
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity), looks genuinely real.
job.meaning: ведущий ~40, тёмные волосы, щетина, тёмно-серый свитер, подкаст-студия с книгами, микрофон
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic frame of a podcast. A warm, thoughtful Russian man about 40 with short dark-brown tousled hair, light stubble, brown eyes, wearing a charcoal-grey knitted sweater and a leather-strap watch. He sits at a wooden podcast table with a black studio microphone on a boom arm in front of him to the side, looking straight into the camera, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, sincere kind expression, NO big smile. Medium shot from the chest up, both shoulders in frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 14% below the upper edge, the microphone does not cover the face. Background: dark cosy study with wooden bookshelves, warm pendant lamps, softly blurred. Real camera frame, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
